title: Visible light promoted metal and oxidant-free stereoselective synthesis of functionalized succinimides from aza-1,6-enynes
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00753K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shivam A. Meena, Deepika Thakur, Debanik Panda, Rahul Ranjan, Akhilesh K. Verma
An operationally simple and visible light promoted approach has been developed for synthesizing diversely functionalized succinimides under transition-metal and oxidant-free conditions in PEG-400.
